name: Akello Jones
source: Mature and methodical, Akello thought he was going through a rough patch after his divorce but when danger threatens his only son, he takes a Faustian demon deal to save him.  Now he turns into a virulent slime monster and his family thinks he's dead.  With nothing left to loose, Akello pours all his energy into learning about his new powers and what threats stalk the city in the dark.
